scientific_claim: Under the frozen DGR-1 raw-byte matrix, the fixed 16-cell Yggdrasil ring reproducibly differentiated one specialized cell for each of eight predictive motifs, achieved perfect held-out successor prediction, lost the full predictive benefit under specialized-cell ablation, and produced no true-motif specialization or predictive benefit under the frequency-matched successor-shuffled control.
next_question: Under a fixed resource ceiling, can those developmentally specialized raw-byte motifs be consolidated into cheaper higher-span representations while preserving capability?
